title: Adeptus Mechanicus Rules
subtitle: Complete local reference for Faction Pack v1.2, including Warhammer Legends

options.label: Protector
options.subtitle: Ballistic protocol
effects: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [HEAVY] ability.
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Each time a melee attack targets this unit, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

options.label: Conqueror
options.subtitle: Assault protocol
effects: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

detachments.title: Cohort Acquisitus
detachments.tagline: Adapted Skitarii hunters identify and eliminate targets in the Quest for Knowledge.

rule.title: Noospheric Recon
rule.text:
- Friendly PTERAXII/INFILTRATORS/RANGERS/SERBERYS RAIDERS/ SERBERYS SULPHURHOUNDS units have RECON AUGURY.
- Friendly RECON AUGURY units have the following ability:
Enhanced Augurs: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one visible enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is analysed:
- While a unit is analysed, that unit has +3" detection range.

enhancements.title: Explorator Dispensation
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. This unit has Infiltrators

enhancements.title: Stealth-screened Cybercanids Upgrade
enhancements.text: SERBERYS RAIDERS unit only. This unit has Lone Operative 15".

stratagems.title: Defect Scrutiny
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly RECON AUGURY unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.title: Repolarised Augurs
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged RECON AUGURY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has -3" detection range until the end of the turn.

stratagems.title: Clandestine Reposition
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

detachments.title: Lords of the Forge
detachments.tagline: Senior cyber-clergy and technohierarchs marshal the Machine God's devout.

rule.title: War-form Mantles
rule.text:
Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have:
- 4+ InSv.
- Feel No Pain 5+.
Friendly TECH-PRIEST models have the following ability:
Baffling Data Screed: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can use this ability. If you do, roll one D6:
- On a 2+, select one enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. A unit cannot be selected for this ability more than once per turn.
- Or: On 2+, those ranged attacks do not prevent this unit from being hidden.

enhancements.title: Vingh's Wafers of Dynamism
enhancements.text: CYBERNETICA DATASMITH model only. At the start of the first battle round, if this unit is an attached unit, this unit has MOBILE until the end of the battle.

enhancements.title: TL-4Ø9
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. The bearer gains TL-4Ø9: Range 24", A 3, BS 2+, S 11, AP -2, D D3+2, [DEVASTATING WOUNDS, HAZARDOUS].

stratagems.title: Scriptural Prognosis
stratagems.when: In your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.title: Overloaded Safeguards
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

stratagems.title: Holy Avarice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TECH-PRIEST unit starts an action.
stratagems.effect: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

detachments.title: Luminen Auto-choir
detachments.tagline: Electro-Priests harness the Motive Force with ecstatic empowering chants. Unique: Data-Psalm.

rule.title: Cyber-static Canticles
rule.text:
- Friendly CORPUSCARII units’ ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
- When a friendly FULGURITE unit has fought, that unit heals D3 wounds.

enhancements.title: Voltagheist Reliquary
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks

enhancements.title: Electromiasmic Brazier

stratagems.title: Echoes of the Conduit Wars
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a unit within range of an objective can: - Re-roll hit rolls of 1. - Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.title: Chant of Electrotraction

stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

detachments.title: Eradication Cohort
detachments.tagline: Purely offensive Skitarii formations driven by the Omnissiah's murderous imperative.

rule.title: Murderous Imperative
rule.text:
Each time a model in a SKITARII unit from your army makes an attack:
- If the Protector Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
- If the Conqueror Imperative is active for that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.title: Omnicogitator
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. The Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.title: Martial Signatum Amplificator
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the SKITARII keyword.

enhancements.title: Belicosa-class Capacitor Vanes
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit, and add 1 to the Strength characteristic of those weapons.

enhancements.title: Omnissiah's Fury
enhancements.text: SKITARII MARSHAL model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

stratagems.title: Servo-driven Charge
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.title: Threat-cogitation Targeters
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

stratagems.title: Unrelenting Aggression
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit has the SKITARII keyword, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead.

stratagems.title: Precision Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a SICARIAN unit from your army declares a charge.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.title: Unshackled Wrath
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase.

stratagems.title: Analytic Reprisals
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One SKITARII INFANTRY unit from your army that lost one or more models as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

detachments.title: Haloscreed Battle Clade
detachments.tagline: Tech-Priests project fragments of their consciousness through the noosphere to override their thralls.

rule.title: Noospheric Transference
rule.text:
In your Command phase, select one or more ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units from your army (including units that are embarked within TRANSPORTS). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
INCURSION:1 UNITSTRIKE FORCE2 UNITSONSLAUGHT3 UNITS
Until the start of your next Command phase, those units gain the HALO OVERRIDE keyword. Then, select one of the Override abilities below. Until the start of your next Command phase, units from your army with the HALO OVERRIDE keyword have the selected Override ability:
Electromotive Energisation
Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.
Microactuator Bracing
Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in this unit.
Predation Protocols
This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Muted Servomotors
Models in this unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.title: Transoracular Dyad Wafers
enhancements.text: CYBERNETICA DATASMITH model only. When the bearer is attached to a KASTELAN ROBOTS unit, until the end of the battle, models in that unit gain the HALO OVERRIDE keyword. That unit cannot be selected when selecting units as part of the Noospheric Transference Detachment rule.

enhancements.title: Cognitive Reinforcement
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only (excluding CYBERNETICA DATASMITH models). The Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.title: Sanctified Ordnance
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model only. Add 6" to the range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit and, each time a Hazardous test is taken for that unit, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.title: Inloaded Lethality
enhancements.text: TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS or TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS model only. Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons and add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

stratagems.title: Eradication Protocols
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.title: Aggressive Impulse
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One SKORPIUS DUNERIDER model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

stratagems.title: Targeting Override
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.title: Guided Retreat
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army makes a Fall Back move.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and, if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for it.

stratagems.title: Neural Overload
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is a HALO OVERRIDE unit, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Select one Override ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active for your unit. Designer’s Note: This means that if the targeted unit already has the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it can be affected by multiple Override abilities at the same time, but suffers mortal wounds to do so. Alternatively, if your unit does not have the HALO OVERRIDE keyword, it instead has the chosen Override ability until the start of your next Command phase, but does not benefit from any other Override abilities that are active.

stratagems.title: Analytical Divination
stratagems.category: Haloscreed Battle Clade – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit (excluding KATAPHRON units) from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" instead if it is a HALO OVERRIDE unit.

updates.title: Faction Pack Rules Updates
updates.summary: Updated Doctrina Imperatives, Cohort Cybernetica, Rad-zone Corps, Skitarii Hunter Cohort, datasheet profiles, abilities and keywords.

updates.title: FAQ and Additional Datasheet Updates
updates.summary: Q: If Auto-divinatory Targeting changes a unit's Ballistic Skill to 3+ while Protector Imperative is active, in what order are the modifiers applied? A: First change Ballistic Skill to 3+, then improve it by 1 with Protector Imperative, for a final result of 2+ (assuming no other modifiers apply).

glossary.title: Heavy
glossary.summary: Weapon ability used by Protector Imperative.
glossary.full: A ranged weapon with Heavy receives the current Core Rules benefit when its unit Remains Stationary.

glossary.title: Assault
glossary.summary: Weapon ability used by Conqueror Imperative.
glossary.full: A unit with Assault weapons can remain eligible to shoot after Advancing, following the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Ignores Cover
glossary.summary: The target cannot receive the Benefit of Cover against this attack.
glossary.full: Resolve the ability using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Feel No Pain
glossary.summary: A wound-prevention roll made after a model would lose a wound.
glossary.full: Use the listed Feel No Pain value and the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Lethal Hits
glossary.summary: A Critical Hit automatically wounds the target.
glossary.full: Resolve Critical Hits using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Stealth
glossary.summary: A defensive Core ability used by several Mechanicus rules.
glossary.full: Resolve Stealth using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Devastating Wounds
glossary.summary: Critical Wounds use the Devastating Wounds sequence.
glossary.full: Resolve the ability using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Sustained Hits
glossary.summary: Critical Hits score the listed number of additional hits.
glossary.full: Resolve additional hits using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Anti-Vehicle
glossary.summary: Unmodified successful Wound rolls at the listed value score Critical Wounds against VEHICLE units.
glossary.full: Resolve Anti abilities using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Anti-Infantry
glossary.summary: Unmodified successful Wound rolls at the listed value score Critical Wounds against INFANTRY units.
glossary.full: Resolve Anti abilities using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Blast
glossary.summary: Blast weapons gain attacks against larger target units and cannot be fired into Engagement Range.
glossary.full: Resolve Blast using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Lance
glossary.summary: A charging model receives the current Lance wound modifier.
glossary.full: Resolve Lance using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Hazardous
glossary.summary: After attacking, take Hazardous tests for weapons with this ability.
glossary.full: Resolve Hazardous tests using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Infiltrators
glossary.summary: Deployment ability granted by Explorator Dispensation.
glossary.full: Resolve deployment using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Lone Operative
glossary.summary: Limits targeting of the unit outside the listed range.
glossary.full: Resolve Lone Operative using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Rapid Fire
glossary.summary: Adds the listed attacks while the target is within half range.
glossary.full: Resolve Rapid Fire using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Torrent
glossary.summary: Attacks with this weapon automatically hit.
glossary.full: Resolve Torrent using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Melta
glossary.summary: Adds the listed Damage while the target is within half range.
glossary.full: Resolve Melta using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Pistol
glossary.summary: Pistol weapons follow the current close-range shooting permissions.
glossary.full: Resolve Pistol using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Twin-linked
glossary.summary: Attacks made with this weapon can re-roll the Wound roll.
glossary.full: Resolve Twin-linked using the current Core Rules.

glossary.title: Doctrina Imperatives
glossary.summary: The Adeptus Mechanicus Army Rule with Protector and Conqueror modes.
glossary.full:
PROTECTOR IMPERATIVE
Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [HEAVY] ability.
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Each time a melee attack targets this unit, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

CONQUEROR IMPERATIVE
Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

glossary.title: Recon Augury
glossary.summary: Cohort Acquisitus keyword and Enhanced Augurs carrier.
glossary.full: A RECON AUGURY unit can analyse a visible enemy within 12 inches in its Shooting phase.

glossary.title: Halo Override
glossary.summary: Temporary keyword granted by Noospheric Transference.
glossary.full: HALO OVERRIDE units gain the selected Override ability and improve several Haloscreed Stratagems.

glossary.title: Data-Psalm
glossary.summary: Unique Detachment tag used by Luminen Auto-choir.
glossary.full: A DATA-PSALM Detachment cannot be taken with another DATA-PSALM Detachment.

glossary.title: Warhammer Legends
glossary.summary: Datasheets intended for the Warhammer Legends rules environment.
glossary.full: Check the current event pack and organiser guidance before using Legends datasheets in matched play.
